newsitem.title: USA: Mattel expects to meet 1997 targets.
newsitem.headline: Mattel expects to meet 1997 targets.

text.p: Mattel Inc said Thursday it expected to meet its targets for the year following its merger with Tyco Toys Inc last month.

"Our integration and restructuring activities are well underway, and will result in global growth opportunities and pre-tax savings of $60 million this year and $160 million per year in 1998 and beyond," it said. "We remain solidly on track to achieve our full-year targets for 1997."
Mattel, which makes children's toys, reported a first-quarter loss of $0.72 a share against a profit of $0.07 for the same period last year. The loss was due to charges related to the merger.
